issues.detail: Spec does not explicitly state 12-hour rollover/PM-toggle boundary; contract infers standard, but alternative hour rollover is plausible.
issues.spec_evidence: Create a set of counters suitable for use as a 12-hour clock (with am/pm indicator).
issues.alternative: Hour rolls 12->01 on the first enabled increment from 12:00:00 (hh=0x01, ss=0x01) instead of after 12:59:59.
